test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lw_pk_empty_in (id UUID, ts DateTime, c1 String, c2 String) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(ts) ORDER BY (id, ts, c1)
CREATE TABLE lw_pk_empty_in_set (c1 String) ENGINE = Null
CREATE TABLE lw_pk_empty_in_null_set (c1 Nullable(String)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO lw_pk_empty_in SELECT generateUUIDv4(), toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + number * 7, toString(number % 100000), concat('v', toString(number % 1000)) FROM numbers_mt(20000000)
test.query: SELECT c1, min(ts) FROM lw_pk_empty_in WHERE c1 IN (SELECT c1 FROM lw_pk_empty_in_set) AND c2 LIKE '%v1%' GROUP BY c1
SELECT c1, min(ts) FROM lw_pk_empty_in WHERE c1 IN (SELECT c1 FROM lw_pk_empty_in_null_set) AND c2 LIKE '%v1%' GROUP BY c1
